function.name: lookup_shipment
function.description: Look up a TrackLine shipment by tracking number. Returns a status summary to read out, and a ticket_id if the shipment was escalated automatically.

tracking_number.description: Tracking number exactly as the caller said it, e.g. "T L 2 0 4 8 1 7 3 6"

messages.content: Let me check that for you.
The lookup failed. Apologise and offer to transfer the caller to a person.
